title: Hivemind Concept - Busy Hive
alt: Concept art of bees at work inside their hive, overseen by their crowned queen.
description: Various bees travel to and fro within their hive, some of them carrying distinctive characteristics such as double stingers or an anglerfish lure; their crowned queen oversees the work.

title: Forget Me
alt: A blue dragon humanoid curled around a glowing orb on a paper-strewn floor, crying.
description: A blue dragon humanoid lies on a gray wooden floor surrounded by messy papers. Her body and tail are curled around a central orb that gives off a diffused yellow light, which shines on the tears in her eyes.

title: The Inventor
alt: Reference sheet for a blue dragon humanoid woman shown in two outfits.
description: A fit blue dragon humanoid woman with hanging thread-like frills and accents of yellow in her eyes, tail, and talons. Sketchy studies of her trapezoidal head shape accompany two illustrations of her in different outfits: first, simple everyday attire with deep navy shorts and a burgundy top; second, adventuring gear with a large yellow jumper and pieces of ceramic armor on top.

title: The Fighter
alt: Reference sheet for a one-eyed human fighter with a mechanical right arm.
description: A muscular human man with olive skin, blond hair, and a goatee. His left eye is missing and covered by an eyepatch, leaving a single green eye, and his right arm is entirely mechanical. He wears simple vertically striped clothes, wields a broken claymore in one hand, and carries a small battle hammer at his side. Lightning surges through his body when he is angered.

title: Demidi
alt: Reference sheet for Demidi, a plus-sized satyr woman with a wooden mask and prosthetic leg.
description: A plus-sized satyr woman with black skin, bright green eyes, and golden locks cut at neck height that frame her face. She has a gap-toothed smile and wears a wooden mask over the right side of her face. The arm on that side is missing and the stump is held in a brace, while the leg is replaced at the knee by a wooden prosthetic. She is dressed in vivid greens, her nails are painted cyan, her skin carries white markings in a Greco-Roman style, and her body is adorned with jewelry: a nose ring, earrings, a glass heart necklace, and a ring on her finger.

title: Flipper Teller
alt: Reference sheet for Flip, a vulture humanoid man in a burgundy vest and gold accessories.
description: A thin vulture humanoid man with cream feathers and deep blue skin underneath. His eyes are bright yellow and his skin has gradients of maroon mixed in. The feathers on his head are slicked back, and he wears an intricate burgundy vest with fitted brown pants and open-taloned boots. Golden accessories cover him: gauntlets fit his hands, a pointed piece adorns his beak, and round, red-tinted glasses are strung around his head.

title: Pinocchio
alt: Reference sheet for Pinocchio, a splintered wooden puppet creature with a single eye hole.
description: A wooden, doll-like humanoid creature with dark, dead splinters covering its head and back. It is held like a puppet, strung by invisible strings, and its features are quite round, like joints fitted together on a mannequin. A single hole sits on its face, with a reddened, fiery eye sometimes peering through.

title: The Batless Are Playing
alt: A colorful gig poster for the fictional band The Batless, centered on an eldritch eye.
description: An extremely colorful poster for the fictional band 'The Batless'. The four members of the band stand on pillars of different heights, looking down at the viewer, while an eldritch eye takes the focal point of the piece, with ominous rays of pure light extending forward like tentacles. Beyond the edges of the poster, an explosion of colors draws the viewer in.

title: Accursed Creation
alt: A pyramid-headed sorcerer conjuring a creature of ink from a boiling cauldron.
description: A humanoid sorcerer with a yellow pyramid for a head performs a ritual in front of a boiling cauldron, manifesting an amalgamation of ink from the stewing pot. The background melts into sickly greens that follow the smoke of the cauldron. He wears a red hood covered in gold, with bags of money around his waist, and each side of his pyramid face bears a glowing green eye.

title: Token - Atlas
alt: A round character token of Atlas, a white metal construct with a glowing blue orb.
description: A round token depicting an artificial construct made of white metal. The image centers on its midsection, where a blue orb floats surrounded by a powerful golden shine, mirrored by the glowing eyes above. The metal looks old, dirty, and rusted. A circular border of deep blue scales with golden highlights frames the piece.

title: Hachi
alt: Hachi, a small corgi humanoid in a red hood, looking up at the viewer.
description: A small humanoid corgi with orange fur and green eyes, looking up innocently at the viewer. They wear a large red hood with azure overalls underneath. Their ears are pricked up in attention, and they stand sheepishly with their hands and feet together, waiting patiently.

title: Atlas
alt: Reference sheet for Atlas, a bulky rusted automaton with a floating blue orb core.
description: A large, bulky, artificial construct of humanoid proportions. The automaton lacks a proper torso, as its bust simply floats above its waist. Its legs and arms are long, extendable tubes ending in rough square hands and boots. Signs of rust and dirt cover its entire surface, making the ceramic-like material underneath look grayish and moldy. A blue orb floats effortlessly at its center, carvings of golden light etched across its surface, the same light that is visible inside its head through its eye lenses.

title: CTRL-Z Animation Cycles
alt: Pixel animation cycles for the CTRL-Z protagonist: standing, idle, and running.
description: A simple pixelated humanoid character with a blue cap and pants and orange overalls. They are shown first standing still, then in their idle animation, and finally in their running animation.

title: Flip Animated Token
alt: An animated pixel token of Flip, a vulture humanoid, in an idle breathing cycle.
description: A pixelated humanoid vulture with cream feathers, deep blue skin, and golden ornaments. In his idle animation, he brings his shoulders down for a breath and clenches his fist, adorned with a golden gauntlet, before relaxing again.

title: Whisper Animated Token
alt: An animated pixel token of Whisper, a hooded crow humanoid, inspecting a gold coin.
description: A pixelated humanoid crow with dark purple feathers and skin, wearing a hood of the same hue and goggles that cover his face. In his idle animation, he bends his knees, pulls out a golden coin, inspects it, and puts it back in his pocket.

title: Hivemind Concept - Characters
alt: Concept art of stylized bees and a hornet, showing varied species designs.
description: Simple stylized insects: mostly bees, surrounding a hornet that carries a health bar, alongside a moth. The bees vary in species and color, and some have unique characteristics such as a carapace-covered body, a round smiley face, an anglerfish head, and a split stinger.

title: Hivemind Concept - Surrounded
alt: Concept art of a panicked bee surrounded by the silhouettes of three predators.
description: A bee at the center is surrounded by the dark silhouettes of a wasp, an ant, and a spider. The eyes of all three adversaries are a striking, enraged red, while the bee is drawn over a calming light blue but looks panicked.

title: Hivemind Concept - Flooded
alt: Concept art of two bees watching a storm approach from a bare tree branch.
description: Two bees fly out from the naked branches of a tree to look at the approaching gray skies of a coming storm, while small droplets of rain have already begun falling on them.

title: Human Flip Teller
alt: A bust portrait of Flip in human form, with slicked yellow hair and tinted glasses.
description: The bust of a thin, pallid man with silky yellow hair slicked back and golden eyes with heavy bags underneath. He wears round, red-tinted glasses with golden frames, rings on his blue lips and ears, and an elegant green tie over a light blue shirt and a burgundy vest.

title: Product of Hate
alt: A bloated, worm-like creature with stump limbs and smoking hollow eyes.
description: A lumpy, wrinkly, overly detailed creature with a worm-like structure. All of its segments look inflated, as if the organs underneath were ready to burst through the gray, ashen skin, and its veins burn through the thin layer like coursing lava. Its appendages have been reduced to rounded stumps, and its eyes are empty white cavities that emanate smoke. The ground around the creature's inhuman mass is covered in dark red stains.

title: Caino Longivito
alt: Reference sheet for Caino, an owl humanoid plague doctor, with an elf companion.
description: A fit humanoid owl man with chocolate and milk feathers and deep, dark eyes with orange irises. Feathers on the left side of his cranium are missing, exposing the skin around his left eye, which has turned a blind gray with veiny streaks of sickly green. He wears a full-body plague doctor outfit in browns, creams, and dark reds, with a sealed brass mask fitted to his hood. Beside him stands a companion: a smaller elf woman with a purple complexion, white hair, and brass limbs.
